name: yangweijie/typephp-qt
description: Rapid development framework for native desktop GUI applications built with TypePHP (AOT-compiled PHP) and Qt 6 — declarative widget tree, one-command build, self-verifying packaging and headless testing.

scripts-descriptions.doctor: Check the local toolchain (Qt, MSVC, tpc) and print actionable fixes.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the framework test suite — headless, no Qt or compiler required.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Validate the bridge contract: stub signatures vs. C++ symbols.
scripts-descriptions.demo:build: Compile the bundled example app with tpc.
scripts-descriptions.demo:run: Deploy Qt deps and run the example app.
scripts-descriptions.demo:package: Assemble and self-verify a shippable dist/ folder for the example.
